questions.q: Explain each feature of a vacuum flask.
questions.a: Vacuum: no conduction or convection; silvered walls: reduce radiation; stopper: reduces convection and evaporation

questions.q: Why does a metal bench feel colder than wood at the same temperature? (2)
questions.a: Metal is a better conductor (1) so transfers energy from your hand faster (1)

questions.q: Explain how a radiator heats a room. (3)
questions.a: Air next to it is heated, expands and becomes less dense (1), rises (1); cooler denser air sinks to replace it, forming a convection current (1)
questions.model: Density change, rise, replacement: three linked marks.

questions.a: Air is a poor conductor and trapped air cannot convect
